definitions.explanation: A substance used to color fabric, yarn, or other materials. Can be natural (from plants, insects) or synthetic (chemical).

examples.japanese: {天然|てんねん}{染料|せんりょう}で{染|そ}めた{布|ぬの}。
{植物|しょくぶつ}から{染料|せんりょう}を{取|と}り{出|だ}す。
{藍|あい}は{日本|にほん}で{古|ふる}くから{使|つか}われてきた{染料|せんりょう}だ。
examples.english: Indigo is a dye that has been used in Japan since ancient times.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天然|てんねん}{染料|せんりょう}: natural dye
- {合成|ごうせい}{染料|せんりょう}: synthetic dye
- {食用|しょくよう}{染料|せんりょう}: food coloring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {顔料|がんりょう}: pigment (insoluble particles mixed into a medium, as opposed to dyes which dissolve)
- {着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}: coloring agent (broader term, includes food coloring)
